shortDescription: A fast, local-first desktop workspace for building, testing, organizing, and sharing HTTP requests—without a required account or hosted workspace.
description:
ReqMint keeps everyday API work focused, fast, and under your control.

Build and send HTTP requests, organize them into local workspaces and collections, switch environments, inspect responses, and run repeatable assertions from one desktop application.

Workspaces are readable files designed for Git. Review ReqMint-managed changes, inspect diffs, and use guarded stage, commit, update, and push flows without silent repository operations.

ReqMint stores settings, bounded history, and sanitized run summaries on your device. Sensitive environment values use the operating system credential vault. There is no required ReqMint account, hosted workspace sync, advertising, or product telemetry in the Community preview.

A guided local tutorial helps you send your first request without contacting a third-party sample API. English and Turkish interfaces, configurable themes, keyboard-friendly workflows, and optional background mode make the app fit different developer setups.

The Community preview is free. Public downloads activate only after release packages pass the required platform, security, installation, update, and removal checks.
features: Build GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD, and OPTIONS requests
Compose query parameters, headers, text, JSON, XML, and form URL-encoded bodies
Organize local workspaces, collections, requests, and environments
Keep sensitive environment values in the operating system credential vault
Search bounded local history with sensitive values redacted
Run collections with assertions, CSV or JSON data, cancellation, exports, and reruns
Review Git changes and use guarded stage, commit, update, and push workflows
Start with a disposable local tutorial API that sends no sample data to third parties
Choose English or Turkish and switch between accessible visual themes
Use optional tray background mode without silently changing close behavior
